name: Alice49 EP.0 "Diamond to Choux Crème"
original_name: Alice49 EP.0『ダイヤモンドとシュークリーム』
source:
An adventure game in which you solve the mystery of a case hidden in an authentic mystery novel. With an emphasis on the classic mystery question "who done it?", the objective of the game is to unravel the true culprit who caused the incident.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2727810]Steam[/url]]
